title: End-of-tenancy cleaning
summary: Move-in and move-out cleaning that leaves the property ready for the état des lieux.

meta.title: End-of-tenancy cleaning in Luxembourg
meta.description: Move-out and move-in cleaning in Luxembourg, scheduled before the état des lieux. A thorough checklist for tenants, landlords and agencies.

hero.intro: A detailed clean timed for the handover, so the property is ready for the état des lieux and the next occupant. For tenants, landlords and estate agencies.

image.alt: An empty, bright apartment with clean floors ready for handover

included.intro: We work through an empty property room by room, following a checklist built around what is usually inspected at handover.

groups.title: Kitchen
items: Oven, hob, extractor and filters degreased
Fridge and freezer cleaned inside, once defrosted
Every cupboard and drawer inside and out

groups.title: Bathrooms
items: Sanitary ware cleaned, disinfected and descaled
Shower screens, mirrors and tiles polished
Drains and overflows cleared of residue

groups.title: All rooms
items: Interior windows, frames, sills and roller shutters
Doors, frames, handles, switches and sockets
Radiators, skirting boards and built-in wardrobes
Floors vacuumed and washed, including corners and edges
Balcony or terrace swept and wiped down

faq.question: Do you guarantee that I get my deposit back?
faq.answer: No cleaning company can guarantee the outcome of an inspection, which also covers wear and damage. If the inspector points out anything about the cleaning we did, tell us within 48 hours and we will come back to put it right.

faq.question: Should the property be empty?
faq.answer: Yes, ideally. An empty property lets us clean inside every cupboard and under every surface. If some furniture stays, tell us when you book.

faq.question: Can you work with my agency's checklist?
faq.answer: Yes. Send it to us before the visit and we will follow it alongside our own.

faq.question: How far ahead should I book?
faq.answer: One to two weeks before your handover is ideal, especially at the end of the month when demand is highest.
